display_long_description:
VR AIM – The Aim Trainer Built for VR Shooters

Stop practicing on flat-screen trainers that don't transfer. VR AIM is designed from the ground up for VR mechanics, helping you build muscle memory that actually matters in-game.
[media]
🔥 **Drills That Matter** – Flicks, tracking, precision, speed. Multiple scenario types designed to target your weak spots and sharpen your strengths.

[media]
🎯 **Your Settings, Your Way** – Match your training to your game. Adjust hand positioning, gun angles, and V-stock settings to feel exactly like VAIL, Pavlov, Breachers, or Onward.

[media]

👥 **Community Presets** – One-click setups from the community. Instantly load settings that match your favorite shooter — no guesswork needed.


[media]

🏆 **Compete & Climb** – Leaderboards for every scenario. See how you stack up and push yourself to beat the best.
